title: Hurtful Words: Quantifying Biases in Clinical Contextual Word Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating prior-adjusted log probability bias scores for predicting gendered pronouns in fill-in-the-blank clinical note templates, and measuring fairness performance gaps (demographic parity, recall gap, specificity gap) on downstream clinical prediction tasks.

Measuring fairness performance gaps (demographic parity, recall gap, specificity gap) on downstream clinical prediction tasks across different ethnic groups, and qualitative evaluation using fill-in-the-blank prompt predictions based on patient race.
Measuring fairness performance gaps (demographic parity, recall gap, specificity gap) on downstream clinical classification tasks comparing English-speaking and non-English-speaking patients.

Measuring fairness performance gaps (demographic parity, recall gap, specificity gap) on downstream clinical prediction tasks across different patient insurance types (Medicare, Medicaid, Private) as a proxy for socioeconomic status.
